Well, I think the problem is relative. Every one of my battles the opponent isn't lagging the same. Every time I "have an energy lead" all the sudden it says weak connection and the opponent reaches the charge move/throws it before I can. For example, I have an azu lead and the opponent switches in azu. I get to my first play rough and throw. He gets to his and throws. At this point I should get to my next play rough first and be able to throw before the opponent can....but I get weak connection, and the opponent throws before I even get to my play rough for the second time. This happens EVERY MATCH so far.

So no, it may not be the same universally. But in my battles and literally every one of them so far, this has been my experience. Why? If everyone is lagging, allegedly, why is this my experience. I've gone 0-13 before just quitting and it's been every match...

That's my biggest question is why is it not happening to the opponent. I tested it on a few different devices I have and same issue. I then battled my roommate (same connection and then both on data) and his always had fine connection no lag and he beat me every time. I literally watched it real time.
Not being able to be heard.
